transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I… well, I lost my temper at one of the younger volunteers. It was over something stupid, a crooked tablecloth. I don’t usually talk to people like that, so… that’s why I came in.
Has losing your temper like that happened to you before?
Not like that, no. I mean… I can get annoyed like anyone, but blowing up over a crooked tablecloth at that young volunteer—that’s not how I usually talk to people.
Have you been feeling more irritable lately, outside of this one incident?
Maybe a bit. Mostly it’s that one thing… snapping at the young volunteer over the tablecloth. That’s not like me, and it bothered me.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or urges to do things in a specific way?
I don’t think so. Not that I’ve noticed, anyway… I’m not really doing things in any particular way like that.
Do you feel a strong need to perform certain rituals or routines in your daily life?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not one for rituals, really. Nothing I feel I have to do like that.
Do you find yourself being very particular about details in your work or daily activities?
Not especially, no. I mean… I like things decent enough, but I don’t think I’m overly particular about details.
Have you always been someone who gets annoyed easily or is this something that has changed over time?
It’s changed, I think. I’m not usually one to snap at people. What brought me in was… I blew up at one of the younger volunteers over a crooked tablecloth. That’s not how I normally talk to people.
Do you feel like there's a right and wrong way to do things, and that doing them the wrong way bothers you?
I don’t know that I’d put it that strongly. Some things are better done a certain way, sure, but I don’t usually get bothered just because someone does it different.
Do you often find yourself getting upset when others don't follow the rules or do things the way you think they should?
Not often, no. But… lately, I guess I did. That thing with the tablecloth at the volunteer place—I snapped at a younger volunteer over it being crooked. I don’t usually talk to people that way.
Has your irritability been present for a long time or is it something that has developed recently?
Recently. I haven’t always been like that. What made me come in was snapping at one of the younger volunteers over a crooked tablecloth… I don’t usually talk to people that way.
Do you find that your irritability comes and goes, or is it more constant?
It’s not constant, I don’t think. It sort of… comes out. Like with that tablecloth at the volunteer place—I blew up at one of the younger volunteers, and that’s not how I usually talk to people.
Would you say that your irritability is something that has been a part of your personality for as long as you can remember?
No… I wouldn’t say that. It’s more recent. I mean, blowing up at that younger volunteer over a crooked tablecloth—that’s not how I usually am.
Was there something specific going on in your life around the time you lost your temper at the volunteer that might have contributed to how you felt?
Yeah… there was. About a week ago I was robbed outside the bank. Since then I’ve just been… not myself, I guess.
Do you think being robbed outside the bank might have had something to do with why you lost your temper at the volunteer?
Yeah… I think it probably did. I mean, what brought me in was losing my temper at that younger volunteer over a crooked tablecloth. I don’t usually talk to people that way.
How long after being robbed did you start feeling not yourself?
Pretty much right after… I’d say it’s been about a week now, since the robbery.
Do you think the robbery is the main reason you've been feeling irritable and losing your temper?
Yeah… I think so. I mean, I came in because I blew up at that younger volunteer over a crooked tablecloth. That’s not like me.
